description: Create (or fetch) the public view-in-browser link for an individual email - a transactional email, a sequence email, or a standalone template. Accepts an email/template ID or a transactional email's ID or slug; for a sequence email, pass the step's emailId from get_sequence. The hosted page renders an anonymized copy - sample contact, inert unsubscribe link, no open/click tracking - so the URL is safe to forward to anyone. Idempotent: if a link is already active, the same URL is returned with created=false rather than rotating it, so previously shared copies keep working. get_template reports the current link as shareUrl (null when none). Revoke with unshare_template. Campaigns have their own campaign-level link that follows the A/B winning variant - use share_campaign for those.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

templateId.description: Email/template ID, or a transactional email's ID or slug.

name: share_template

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `share_template` MCP tool.

created.description: False when an already-active link was returned instead of minted.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

shareToken.description: Capability token embedded in the URL.

shareUrl.description: Public anonymized view-in-browser URL for the email.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
